text: Self-improvement cycle 3: reject invalid and budget-exceeding benchmark telemetry
description: Generated from the recorded cycle-1 reflection that capability comparisons require matched budgets and authoritative evidence. Observed limitation: negative, non-finite, zero-budget, or budget-exceeding telemetry was accepted into benchmark aggregates. Frozen evaluation: require negative intervention counts, NaN token usage, and usage beyond the registered budget to produce an invalid result. Bounded change: validate every numeric field as finite and non-negative, require positive budgets, and reject token/time overruns. Regression gate: full wrapped-agents/common tests, TypeScript type-check, and diff check.

status.comment: Cycle implemented from a recorded system reflection and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: Invalid telemetry can manufacture apparent capability gains; rejecting it makes the recursive-improvement evidence more trustworthy.
